title: Signing Ceremony — Hands
purpose: Agreement and ratification surfaces; ceremony moments.
story: Hands at a formal signing, pen meeting a blank page across the ceremonial table — the instant agreement becomes binding.
environment: A ceremonial table dressed in dark cloth, lit by a single warm source, the hall beyond folded into shadow.
architecture: Implied only — a grand panelled room suggested at the edge of the pooled light.

people.notes: Only two pairs of hands and cuffs are visible across the table; no faces, no bodies above the wrists.

composition: Tight across the table on the hands and pen over a blank folio, warm light raking the cloth, the room dissolving into negative space.
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; the folio page stays blank.
